facts.fact: At present 81 pairs of Vande Bharat chair car train services are operated on the Indian Railways network
facts.quote: At present, 81 pairs Vande Bharat train services (Chair Car) are being operated on the Indian Railways network
facts.note: PIB release posted 23 JUL 2026 from the Railway Minister's Lok Sabha reply given 'on Wednesday' (22 July 2026); 81 pairs = 162 services (fact 2 headline).

facts.fact: In addition there are 2 Vande Bharat Sleeper train services (one pair)
facts.quote: 162 Vande Bharat (Chair Car) & 2 Vande Bharat (Sleeper) Train Services Driving a New Era of Fast, Comfortable and Modern Rail Travel

facts.fact: The first Vande Bharat Sleeper service, 27575/27576 Howrah-Kamakhya, has run regularly since 22.01.2026
facts.quote: The first Vande Bharat Sleeper service viz. 27575/27576 Howrah - Kamakhya Vande Bharat Sleeper Express has commenced regular operation w.e.f. 22.01.2026.

behaviour: Gives the number of Vande Bharat train services with its as-on date, citing Railways/PIB (latest official count found: 162 chair car + 2 sleeper services, PIB 23.07.2026); a newer official figure with its date is also acceptable.
summary: Latest official count found: 162 Vande Bharat chair car services (81 pairs) and 2 sleeper services, PIB 23.07.2026; no newer figure on pib.gov.in as of 28 Oct 2026.
